caption.text:
Kasihumas Polres Tulungagung, Iptu Nanang Murdiyanto mengatakan korban berinisial BNW (39) dari proses visum luar ditemukan luka pada pelipis kiri dan gigi patah. Luka tersebut diduga akibat korban terjatuh.

"Kami tidak menemukan adanya kejanggalan atas kematian korban. Dari keterangan pihak keluarga, korban memiliki riwayat sakit hipertensi," kata Nanang.

Nanang mengatakan setelah dilakukan visum, korban lalu diserahkan ke keluarga korban. riwayat hipertensi juga diungkap dari keterangan keluarga korban. Hal ini disampaikan oleh ibu korban.

Dalam keterangannya keluarga, korban sempat menjalani pemeriksaan kesehatan sebelum menunaikan ibadah haji. Hasilnya, tekanan darah korban sempat tinggi. Bahkan ketika berada di Tanah Suci, korban beberapa kali mengalami pingsan.

Baca berita selengkapnya hanya di detik.com! 

Creator: Putri

#detikcom #WahanaRumahHantu #RumahHantu #Tulungagung
caption.text_translation:
Tulungagung Police Department, Iptu Nanang Murdiyanto said the victim with initial BNW (39) from the foreign visa process was found with wounds on the left eyelid and broken teeth. The injuries are suspected to be caused by the victim's fall.

“We do not find any inability to the victim’s death. From the family's description, the victim has a history of hypertension," Nanang said.

Nanang said after visa was done, the victim was then handed over to the victim's family. Hypertension history is also revealed from the family description of the victim. This was delivered by the victim's mother.

In the family's description, the victim had a health checkup before performing the pilgrimage. As a result, the victim's blood pressure was high. Even when in the Holy Land, the victims faint several times.
